requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with Higher Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new generation bottle (NGB) keyed ink bottles with 6,000-page yield for black and CMY, and bottle size for CMY to exceed 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink yield and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, improving customer satisfaction and competitive positioning against CISS competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new or existing ink tanks and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are available for black and CMY, yield at least 6,000 pages for black, 6,000 for CMY, and CMY bottle size supports >8,000-page yield. Verified by yield testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new ink bottles and filling process are spill-free during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is a critical user experience feature, reducing mess and increasing trust in HP’s CISS system.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, IDS, and tank interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during standard bottle installation and use, confirmed via usability and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (non-original ink avoidance filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, maintaining current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances ink security, prevents non-original ink usage, and maintains compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, bottle interface, TDF mechanism.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label passes ink authentication and leak testing, and works with push-push and TDF.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design printer to allow customers to replace the Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F without service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime and service costs, and aligns with customer expectations for ease of maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F mechanical design, user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can successfully replace PHA and NOA-F following provided instructions, confirmed by usability tests.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Set and support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product life, reduces replacement frequency, and increases perceived value for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, consumables life, warranty policy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably for 80,000 pages under standard usage conditions; verified via accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency certifications.
requirements.Rationale: Necessary for regulatory compliance and to meet sustainability goals, especially for institutional and enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, materials, and energy consumption features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel; certification documents available.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes to Align with Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate changes in printer dimensions due to tank protrusion and size optimization.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable paper handling and maintains compact form factor despite larger tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function properly and fit with new tank design; confirmed by fit and functional tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3-inch CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphic display (CGD) for improved user interface and control.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience by providing clear, accessible information and controls.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3-inch CGD is functional, meets brightness and resolution specs, and passes user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management for New Tank
requirements.Description: Redesign service station aerosol management system to accommodate changes from new tank integration.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink aerosol contamination due to new tank design, maintaining print quality and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol containment meets HP standards; verified by environmental and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paper path design to support increased page life and reliability for high duty cycle usage.
requirements.Rationale: Required to ensure reliable operation up to the 80,000-page warranty goal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper jams and misfeeds remain within HP’s acceptable limits over 80,000 pages; verified by life testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as a Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable by service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended printer life and cost-effective post-warranty service.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts post-80,000 pages; confirmed by service procedure validation.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connections for the IDS (Ink Delivery System), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size and keying.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink volumes, improved reliability, and security against non-genuine supplies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS make-break and FI connections function as designed and meet reliability targets; verified by engineering tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to ensure reliable ink flow and startup performance.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for print quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction, especially with new tank and bottle sizes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer starts up reliably under all operating conditions; confirmed by startup and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality goals and depletion metrics to align with increased yield and page life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality is maintained throughout the extended product lifecycle and higher yields.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality remains within HP standards for the defined page yield; validated by print quality and depletion tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Business Models
requirements.Description: Product and solution must support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome, and Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and aligns with HP’s strategic intent to protect and grow share across segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is configurable for all business models and passes acceptance tests for each segment.

requirements.Title: Integration with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD Drivers
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility and integration with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD drivers and client software.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for seamless deployment, management, and user experience across customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and client software are supported and pass integration tests.

requirements.Title: Compliance with HP Security Standards (Gauss4.xx)
requirements.Description: Implement hardware and firmware security features in line with Gauss4.xx standard.
requirements.Rationale: Protects HP’s intellectual property, customer data, and device security.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass HP security audits and meet Gauss4.xx requirements.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for reducing maintenance frequency and supporting high-volume printing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA meets or exceeds 65,000-page life in reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or Specified Pages
requirements.Description: Support a warranty life of 2 years or the specified page count, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations and supports HP’s competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty is honored for 2 years or the specified page count; policy is documented and communicated.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), with PDL variants at 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance requirements for target segments and maintains competitiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in standard benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design maintenance box to be easily serviceable for end users or service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs, improving customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end users or service centers; confirmed by usability testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution and Manageability Features
requirements.Description: Provide solution features and manageability for SMBs, including scan solutions and SMB portal integration.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB segment needs for manageability and workflow integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB manageability features are functional and pass acceptance tests with SMB customers.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK Trade Page (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Design flexibility to host 12,000-page CMYK trade page as a future option.
requirements.Rationale: Allows future scalability and support for higher-yield options as market demands evolve.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and bottle design, IDS scalability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform design allows for future 12K-CMYK option without major redesign.
